catalog.name: SaldeoSMART
catalog.description: Your invoices, documents and bank statements from SaldeoSMART, as agent tools.
catalog.hint: The API reads: companies, contractors, invoices issued in Saldeo, archive documents, bank statements and what Saldeo already settled. It cannot mark anything paid; connect the SaldeoSMART (web) account for that. The switches below are what the agent may read and whether it may propose matches in the Saldeo view's reconciliation sessions.

steps: Sign in as an office-side user (the API is not offered to a client-side login).
Konfiguracja → Konto → Ustawienia API → generate or copy the token.
Paste the login and the token here. The token is stored, never shown again.

fields.label: Company program id
fields.placeholder: leave empty to pick a company in the view
fields.hint: Pins one company (its `company_program_id`). Empty lets the view and the agent choose among the companies the login can see.

fields.label: Read the document archive
fields.hint: Cost and sales documents, with their paid state.

fields.label: Read bank statements
fields.hint: Statements Saldeo holds, and which documents it settled them against.

fields.label: Let the agent propose matches
fields.hint: Proposals land in a reconciliation session for you to confirm. Off = read-only tools.

catalog.name: SaldeoSMART (web)
catalog.description: Mark invoices paid and link transactions in Saldeo, as you.
catalog.hint: The API has no write for payments, so this signed-in browser profile is how confirmed settlements reach SaldeoSMART: the agent opens the invoice or the bank transaction and does what you would. Connect it only if the agent should be able to mark things paid.
